requirements.requirement_text: Manufacturers of devices that provide instructions for use in electronic form to users instead of in paper form shall undertake a documented risk assessment covering specific elements including knowledge and experience of intended users, characteristics of environment, user experience with hardware/software, access to electronic resources, safeguards against tampering, safety mechanisms, emergency situations, website unavailability impact, provision timeframe for paper form, website compatibility, and version management.
